rationale: Synthetic scheduling comparison, not calibrated customer evidence. Processing and disruption draws are identical in both policies. Only noticing, handoffs, preparation timing and concurrency differ.

default_seed.rationale: Fixed public seed makes the pitch reproducible.

default_runs.rationale: A small synthetic cohort smooths sampling noise while running locally.

maximum_runs.rationale: Bound local compute; this is not a statistical power claim.

sensitivity_relative_change.rationale: One-at-a-time plus/minus twenty percent probes numeric assumptions; structural policies also have separate on/off ablations.

collect_documents.rationale: Synthetic document review after retrieving originals; same processing in both policies.

residency_visa.rationale: Illustrative processing variability; no actual ICP timing is asserted.

health_insurance.rationale: Synthetic enrolment window, not a published insurer or DoH commitment.

emirates_id.rationale: Illustrative identity milestone duration, unchanged by assistance.

housing_search.rationale: Synthetic search task; market conditions are not measured.

tawtheeq_register.rationale: Illustrative registration processing; not an authority service-level claim.

bank_account.rationale: Synthetic account-opening processing; no bank approval guarantee.

family_residency.rationale: Synthetic family milestone, not a legal requirement or ICP timing.

school_registration.rationale: Illustrative school task; admissions capacity is outside the model.

trade_name.rationale: Illustrative trade-name processing; no authority deadline.

economic_license.rationale: Synthetic licence window shared across setup paths; no jurisdiction comparison is claimed.

establishment_card.rationale: Synthetic establishment milestone; not actual ICP timing.

visa_quota.rationale: Illustrative sponsorship-readiness task; not legal quota advice.

entity_can_sponsor.rationale: A logical join adds no processing time; predecessor tasks establish modeled readiness.

corporate_bank.rationale: Synthetic company banking window; identical institutional processing in both policies.

fully_settled.rationale: Terminal join, not an additional service.

fully_operational.rationale: Terminal join, not an additional service.

passport.rationale: Synthetic retrieval and preparation of an already-held fake passport.

employment.rationale: Synthetic coordination to obtain employment documents.

family.rationale: Synthetic household-paperwork preparation, not attestation rules.

delay_probability.rationale: An assumed independent disruption rate for positive-duration steps, applied identically to both policies.

unexpected_delay_days.rationale: Synthetic processing disruption; orchestration does not remove institutional delays.

notice_days.rationale: Assumed delay before an unassisted person notices an actionable task or document blocker.

handoff_days.rationale: Assumed manual coordination gap between ready work and starting it.

baseline.rationale: Deliberately sequential comparison: one active step and reactive document retrieval. This assumption can disadvantage baseline and is not a measured description of real newcomers.

notice_days.rationale: Assumed faster notifications, not measured product performance.

handoff_days.rationale: Assumed faster orchestration handoffs; authority processing remains unchanged.

orchestration.rationale: Independent steps and original-document preparation run in parallel when dependencies allow. Unlimited parallel resources are assumed; contention, capacity and human multitasking limits are not modeled.
